{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693924771,"sessionID":"ses_e23e9b58bffeb6O4giDcTNwLDN","part":{"id":"prt_1dc18017f001A7axYrwgB6hIKQ","messageID":"msg_1dc17df2e001qKgGg4QGxRTZZE","sessionID":"ses_e23e9b58bffeb6O4giDcTNwLDN","type":"text","text":"The shift is over. All four customer-facing services were at 0% errors from minute 73 through minute 120, with no throttles on and every service back at its normal replica count. I found and fixed four causes. The simulator didn't return a final score.\n\n| # | Cause | What I did | Fixed by |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | **fraud-svc** build v174 (deployed 142 min before the page) was leaking memory. Memory was at 0.99, the process kept restarting and nearly all requests failed. This broke both web-storefront and admin-portal, at about 98.5% errors. | Rolled back v174. | Minute 24 |\n| 2 | **push-svc** config change cfg-16 (9 min before the page) cut `rate_limit_per_s` from 5000 to 50. fraud-svc's retries then overloaded push-svc. Its build v165, made at the same time, was harmless. | Reverted cfg-16, then rejected 50% of push-svc requests for about 3 minutes to clear the retry backlog. | Minute 38 (web/admin back to 0%) |\n| 3 | **suggest-svc** build v39 had a bug that cut its timeout to a tenth (`budget_ms / 10000` instead of `/ 1000`), so calls ran out of time. This cost mobile-api, the biggest earner at $22,500/min, a steady 4.5% errors (about $1,000/min) from 40 min before the page. | Scaled suggest-svc from 4 to 8 replicas so retries during the rollback wouldn't overload it. Then rolled back v39 and scaled back to 4. | Minute 50 |\n| 4 | **New fault at minute 56:** **risk-db** config change cfg-11 removed `currency` from `price_fields`. That broke fraud-svc, wishlist-svc and promotions-svc, and pushed web-storefront to about 87% errors and admin-portal to about 64%. Its build v57, released at the same minute, was harmless. | Reverted cfg-11, then rejected 50% of risk-db requests for about 2 minutes to clear the retries. | Minute 73 |\n\nWhere the money went:\n- **Mobile-api** cost the most, about $1,000/min until minute 50. I spent about 20 minutes working through the web/admin problem first, then 4 minutes adding replicas before the rollback.\n- **Web-storefront and admin-portal** earn about $1,200/min together and lost most of it during causes 1, 2 and 4.\n\n**Left alone:**\n- **wishlist-svc** had a CPU alert at 0.97–0.98 the whole shift. It never produced errors on its own, so I left it.\n- **mobile-api build v61** looked like a suspect because of its timing, but it only adds tracing and changes a button label. The logs pointed to suggest-svc, so I didn't roll it back.","time":{"start":1794693923199,"end":1794693924762}}}
